site.name: Hallam Interactives
site.tagline: Simulations, games and data tools for class
site.byline: Built for Hallam students by S. Hagemeyer

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.blurb: Real data, and the tools to investigate it.

items.title: Data Lab
items.desc: Pick a real dataset, ask your own question, plot it and fit a line of best fit. Fourteen cleaned datasets, from AFL players to Antarctic penguins, with the instructions built in.

subjects.label: Biology
subjects.blurb: Body systems, cells and plants, all interactive.

items.title: Excretory System
items.desc: Explore the function of ADH in the kidney.

items.title: Islets of Langerhans
items.desc: Understand the presence of alpha and beta cells in the pancreas.

items.title: Blood Glucose Regulation
items.desc: How insulin and glucagon keep blood sugar steady, and what happens when that breaks down.

items.title: Pee Panic
items.desc: An osmoregulation game. Keep the balance, or else.

items.title: SRMER
items.desc: Stimulus and response model scenarios to work through.

items.title: Cell Passport
items.desc: Explore animal and plant cell organelles, stage by stage.

items.title: Plant Parts
items.desc: The macro outline of plant parts and what each one does.

items.title: Photosynthesis
items.desc: Explore how plants adapt photosynthesis to their environment.

subjects.label: IT and Computing
subjects.blurb: The class sites, with real Python running in the browser.

items.title: Hallam IT Basics
items.desc: The Year 7 to 10 computing site: thirteen topic modules, in-browser Python, assignments and your progress.

items.title: PyWebLib
items.desc: A Python playground and sharing community. Turtle graphics, games and a leaderboard.

subjects.label: Games and Misc
subjects.blurb: Physics toys and the odds and ends.

items.title: Under Pressure
items.desc: Gas particles inside a can. Heat it, cool it, and watch what the pressure does.

items.title: Displacement
items.desc: A motion and displacement tracker that follows your mouse.
